record_title: Harmonic accumulation of Hopf envelopes in the ribosome-delay model
provenance: Analytical consequence of the published ribosome-delay characteristic equation, its fixed-dilution Hopf phase parametrization, and compact-branch asymptotics.
limitations: Spectral Hopf-point theorem rather than a complete nonlinear Hopf-bifurcation theorem. The fixed-small-growth proliferation result assumes continuous persistence of the relevant positive-frequency branches to M=1. The source paper reports such a two-root window numerically, but this record does not rigorously certify that entire numerical interval. The full exact 2k-count Conjecture 1 remains open because envelope ordering does not by itself control repeated horizontal intersections.
